description: Checks an EU VAT number in the European Commission VIES register. status: valid (with registered name and address where the country publishes them), invalid, or unavailable (national register busy; try later).

number.description: VAT number with country prefix, e.g. BE0123456749 or NL123456789B01.

name: lookup_vat_number
title: Check an EU VAT number (VIES)
